entities.summary: Theodorus Johannes "Dirk" Graswinckel was a Dutch jurist, a significant writer on the freedom of the seas. He was a controversialist, who also rose to a high legal position where he advised Descartes. He was a cousin and pupil of Grotius. He was also a poet and translator of Thomas à Kempis.
